changelog: Cars to Buy now has a 🔎 Scout Facebook button right in the app. Set your filters (make, model, year, max price, max km) and click it — it sends the Project Snake extension to Facebook Marketplace, runs that search, scouts each keeper for km + details, and drops them back into your Cars to Buy list. No more needing to start the scout from the Facebook panel. (Reload the Snake extension once to pick this up.)
